newsitem.title: USA: Explosion near Planned Parenthood clinic in Washington.
newsitem.headline: Explosion near Planned Parenthood clinic in Washington.

text.p: An explosion outside a Planned Parenthood clinic Wednesday rocked downtown Washington on the anniversary of the Roe vs Wade decision legalizing abortion, a police spokesman said.
The blast occurred shortly before 8 a.m. EST at the clinic at 16th and M Sts NW, about five blocks from the White House.
The police spokesman said that some sort of suspicious "devices" were also found outside of the nearby Mayflower Hotel and that the bomb squad was investigating.
They said a witness reported that a man ran from the scene immediately after the explosion.
Police and fire officials said there was a lot of debris on the street outside the building that houses the clinic and they were checking to see if there were any injuries.

Anti-abortion groups are marking the 24th anniversary of the Supreme Court decision, which made abortion through all nine months of pregnancy legal, with meetings and statements calling for its repeal.
